verdict.rationale: Metronome documents an API for managing the subscription lifecycle: creating contracts, plan upgrades and downgrades, and editing subscriptions via the edit contract endpoint. It also offers bearer-token auth, SDKs, an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt for agent consumption. However, nothing in the evidence shows token scopes or fine-grained permissions, and applying a credit through the API is only implied by prepaid-credit setup docs. Missing for 10: documented scoped/least-privilege API tokens, explicit API endpoint for applying credits to a customer, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven billing operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate my billing — create a subscription, apply a credit, change a plan — through a programmatic surface with scoped permissions

citations.quote: Use the Metronome API to manage your customer's subscription lifecycle including pricing changes, free trials, upgrades, and downgrades.
PLG onboarding: Automatically provision new self-serve customers with contracts when they sign up.
Schedule a change of the quantity of a subscription using the update_subscription action on the edit contract endpoint.
Metronome’s API uses bearer tokens to authenticate requests.
